public_rationale: The numerical assertion is supported under the stated historical scope. This verdict does not establish a current nationwide total or endorse the subjective judgment about policy coherence.
limitations: The verdict depends on reading the abbreviated post with its linked context.
Tracker classifications are broad and need not match counts restricted to comprehensive AI regulation.
The one-bill difference between sources remains unexplained.
The policy-coherence judgment is not scored.
